results.headline: Preliminary Results
results.key_quote: Scancell Holdings plc (AIM: SCLP), the developer of ImmunoBody® and Moditope® active immunotherapies to treat cancer, today announces a business update and provides its unaudited financial results for year ended 30 April 2026.
results.summary: Scancell reported preliminary results for the year ended 30 April 2026 without any explicit comparison to market expectations, analyst forecasts, or board guidance. The announcement focuses on business updates including FDA IND clearance and fast-track designation for Phase 3 iSCIB1+ trial, MHRA authorization in the UK, and progress on the ModiFY trial showing partial responses in head and neck cancer patients. The company also announced a merger with Neuphoria Therapeutics and secured $39.1 million in PIPE financing commitments. No financial metrics are compared against expectations or prior guidance, and no guidance upgrades or downgrades are mentioned.

results.headline: Q3 Trading Update
results.key_quote: The Group remains on track to meet market expectations for the full year.
results.summary: DF Capital reported Q3 2026 results with robust performance explicitly described as 'in line with expectations'. New loan originations reached £561m (up 22% YoY), loan book grew to £929m (up 22% YoY), and portfolio quality improved with arrears declining to 1.3% of the loan book. Asset finance segment showed strong momentum with loan book nearly doubling. The CEO stated the Group 'remains on track to meet market expectations for the full year', confirming performance is consistent with, not ahead of, guidance.

results.headline: Half Year Trading Update & Notice of Results
results.key_quote: Underlying profit before taxation is expected to be up 81% on previous year
results.summary: Motorpoint has delivered strong H1 FY27 results with underlying PBT of c.£6.5m, up 81% year-on-year. The company reports retail volume growth of 7.6%, outperformance against the wider used car market, record metal margins, and improved ROCE to c.80%. Full-year guidance of £9.8m-£10.8m PBT is stated to be 'in line with the recently upgraded market consensus', indicating the company is tracking ahead of prior expectations given the significant upgrade to market consensus guidance.
metrics_ahead: Underlying profit before taxation up 81% YoY
Retail volume growth 7.6% outperforming wider market
Record metal margins achieved
ROCE improved to c.80% from 59%
Full-year guidance in line with recently upgraded market consensus

results.headline: Interim Trading Update
results.key_quote: on account of the strong trading momentum through to 30 September 2026, the Board now expects that full year 2026 revenue and EBITDA will be ahead of market expectations
results.summary: Mincon reports strong Q3 momentum with 9-month revenue 28% ahead of prior year. The Board has upgraded guidance, now expecting full year 2026 revenue and EBITDA to be ahead of market expectations. Strong construction sector growth, particularly from innovative drilled foundations solution (Spiral Flush) in North America, and continued mining business growth across multiple regions. Margin pressures from raw materials have eased, and the company expects further margin improvement in H2 2026 from operating leverage.
metrics_ahead: Revenue 28% ahead of 2025
Full year 2026 revenue expected ahead of market expectations
Full year 2026 EBITDA expected ahead of market expectations

results.headline: Q4 Trading Update
results.key_quote: FY EPS expected to be c.14.0p, up c.18% YoY, in line with expectations and within our guided range
results.summary: SSP Group delivered Q4 LFL sales growth of 4% and expects full-year EPS of c.14.0p, up 18% year-on-year, which is explicitly stated as in line with market expectations and within guided range. Despite significant headwinds from Middle East conflict impact on APAC & EEME passenger numbers, the company is executing its recovery plan well, with Continental Europe margins expected to improve to c.3% from 2.2%. Free cash flow expected to be c.£70m with material underlying improvement year-on-year. Performance is tracking to expectations rather than materially ahead.
metrics_ahead: Continental Europe operating margin improvement on track
Q4 LFL sales growth of 4%
Free cash flow expected to show material underlying improvement YoY

results.headline: Final Results to 30 June 26
results.key_quote: the Company has outperformed the benchmark in eight of the past ten financial years ending 30th June 2026, delivering average annualised returns of +14.1% over this period
results.summary: JPMorgan Global Growth & Income delivered mixed performance relative to expectations. Over one year, NAV total return of +16.7% underperformed the MSCI All Countries World Index benchmark at +27.7%, materially lagging expectations. However, over five-year and ten-year periods, the Company outperformed its benchmark (76.9% vs 75.3% five-year; 273.0% vs 235.4% ten-year), with the Company described as 'one of the top performers in its peer group' over these longer timeframes. The Company remains confident in its strategy and has delivered eleven consecutive years of dividend increases. The one-year underperformance was attributed to unfavourable stock selection and underestimation of AI market impact.
metrics_ahead: five-year NAV cumulative total return ahead of benchmark
ten-year NAV cumulative total return substantially ahead of benchmark
top performer in peer group over five and ten years
eleven consecutive years of dividend increases

results.headline: Trading Update and Strategic Update
results.key_quote: Trading since the publication of the interim results has been below the Board's expectations, reflecting changes in Vicon's established end markets, pressure on research funding and delays to major projects in Industrial Vision and Metrology Systems. The Board now expects FY26 revenue of £47.0m to £51.0m and Adjusted EBIT loss of -£0.5m to -£3.9m, which is below current market expectations.
results.summary: Oxford Metrics has reported trading below Board expectations since June 2026, with FY26 revenue and Adjusted EBIT guidance below current market expectations. The company faces headwinds from reduced investment in film, television and games, constrained research funding particularly in the US, and delays to major projects in IVMS. However, FY27 Adjusted EBIT is expected to be at or above market expectations of £3.5m, though FY27 revenue is expected below market expectations. The company is implementing cost savings and strategic initiatives including acquisitions (move:ai and Captive Devices) to improve future performance.

results.headline: Blanket Mine Q3 Production and Revised guidance
results.key_quote: Production in the third quarter was below our expectations, principally due to insufficient compressed air capacity in deeper, higher-grade mining areas and the temporary retention of gold within the processing circuit.
results.summary: Caledonia Mining has lowered its full-year 2026 production guidance for Blanket Mine from 72,000-76,500 ounces to 69,000-72,500 ounces due to Q3 production falling short of expectations. Q3 production of 17,030 ounces was below the prior year quarter (19,106 ounces) and the company's own expectations. The shortfall was caused by compressed air supply constraints at deep, high-grade mining areas and temporary gold retention in the metallurgical plant during equipment commissioning. Management expects Q4 improvements but has acknowledged the quarterly underperformance and the need to revise guidance downward.

results.headline: Q3 2026 Palm Oil and Cashew Production Update
results.key_quote: Q3 represents the seasonal low point for Fresh Fruit Bunch ('FFB') availability. Despite this, the Palm Oil Operation delivered Crude Palm Oil ('CPO') production broadly in line with Q3 2025, with a stronger finish to the quarter in September... The Cashew Operation delivered its strongest quarter to date, processing 2,130 tonnes of Raw Cashew Nuts ('RCN'), an average of c.710 tonnes per month and above the 700-tonne monthly run rate previously targeted.
results.summary: Mixed performance across operations. Palm Oil Operation delivered CPO production broadly in line with prior year during seasonally weak Q3, with stable extraction rates and historically elevated pricing. However, CPO sales volumes declined 6.6% year-on-year. Cashew Operation significantly outperformed, achieving strongest quarter to date with 71.1% increase in production and 72.3% increase in sales volumes, exceeding the previously targeted 700-tonne monthly run rate with an average of 710 tonnes per month. Overall classification is AHEAD primarily due to the Cashew Operation's material outperformance against stated targets, offsetting the more modest Palm Oil results.
metrics_ahead: Cashew production increased 71.1% to 657 tonnes, highest quarterly level to date
Cashew sales volumes increased 72.3% to 679 tonnes, highest quarterly level to date
Monthly cashew processing rate averaged 710 tonnes per month, above the previously targeted 700-tonne run rate
PKO production more than doubled year-on-year at 103.3% increase
PKO sales volumes increased 79.2% year-on-year

results.headline: UPDATE: First Majestic Reports Q3 2026 Produc...
results.key_quote: Silver Production (72% of guidance midpoint): The Company produced 3.4 million silver ounces in the quarter, reaching 72% of the 2026 revised guidance midpoint. The lower production was mostly driven by a labour dispute at San Dimas, which impacted the operations by 12 days in Q3 2026.
results.summary: First Majestic reported Q3 2026 production significantly below guidance expectations. Silver production reached only 72% of the revised 2026 guidance midpoint, materially missing expectations due to a 12-day labour disruption at San Dimas. Gold production at 75% of guidance midpoint also fell short. While the company noted positive developments at Santa Elena, Los Gatos, and Jerritt Canyon restart progressing ahead of plan, the core quarterly production metrics were substantially below stated guidance, representing an unfavorable variance.
metrics_ahead: Jerritt Canyon restart progressing ahead of plan
Gold production aligned with revised guidance despite disruptions
Safety performance remains strong
La Encantada delivered strong production
